bhakoota.description: The couple will have great emotional connectivity between them. This score is extremely important for matchmaking as it contributes 7 points alone. Bhakoot is extremely important because it tests the conflict resolution patterns. While there are small hiccups in every relationship, one thing that is sure with this score is that the conflicts that may arise will be solved just by a fun chuckle and things will never be complicated.

nadi.description: Nadi matching is considered the most crucial factor. Its importance lies heavily in the fact that the points obtained in this category have the highest impact on health and progeny. The couple will have a good sense of attraction and care towards each other and there will be a high probability of healthy and strong progeny. This is a very auspicious sign for the growth and nurturing of the marital relationship.

ashtakoot_milan_result.content: The compatibility score between the QA Kavin and QA Ananya is 20 out of 36, which is considered reasonably good. Additionally, their zodiac signs are friendly, indicating mental compatibility and mutual affection. Overall, it's a favorable match according to Ashtakoota.
